enemies.name: The Last Lamplighter
enemies.desc: An old man keeping the last lamp of the drowned king lit. If he falls, the lamp goes out.

encounters.name: The Night Patrol
encounters.desc: Three soldiers of a drowned king, still walking the rounds. They hold the line: step away from one and it swings.
encounters.intro: They still walk the rounds. Nobody told them the kingdom is underwater.

encounters.name: Shooting Gallery
encounters.desc: Crossbowmen behind crates. Close the distance; their harpoons drag stragglers out of cover.
encounters.intro: Mind the crates. They are the only things in the kingdom that still float.

encounters.name: The Mudflats
encounters.desc: Mud costs two to cross. Mudlarks hide and hook whoever wanders off alone.
encounters.intro: Stay together. Things in the mud prefer people on their own.

encounters.name: The Heralds
encounters.desc: Bloated heralds walk up to you and burst. Kill them before they arrive; their bile lingers on the floor.
encounters.intro: They come bearing news. The news is mostly bile.

encounters.name: Evening Service
encounters.desc: A tide-priest heals the drowned and floods the floor. Reach it first, or fight through deep water.
encounters.intro: The service is well attended. The congregation is mostly wet.

encounters.name: The Shield Line
encounters.desc: Two bulwarks hold the corridor. They shrug off blades; lightning and fire find the gaps. The crossbow behind them is the soft part.
encounters.intro: A shield wall. Very traditional. Very crusted.

encounters.name: The Broken Bridge
encounters.desc: A bridge with holes in it. Anything shoved into a hole is gone, yours included. Harpoons pull.
encounters.intro: The bridge is mostly holes. I'd keep your back to something solid.

encounters.name: Ambush at the Weir
encounters.desc: You are surrounded and they move first. Back to back.
encounters.intro: Ah. You were not the first to arrive. They go first.

encounters.name: Rising Water
encounters.desc: Every round the water rises and three more tiles flood. Floodwater is slow and slows whoever ends a turn in it.
encounters.intro: The water is rising. I would hurry. The water would not.

optional.text: Win before the islands sink (4 rounds)

encounters.name: The Last Lamplighter

waves.say: More of them. They have come for the lamp.

encounters.desc: Keep the old lamplighter alive. He cannot move. Enemies arrive in rounds 2 and 3.
encounters.intro: He has kept that lamp lit since the water came. Keep him alive and he might tell you why.

encounters.name: Out Through the Sluice
encounters.desc: You do not have to win. Get every hero onto the exit tiles at the top left. Killing everything also works, if you can.
encounters.intro: There is a sluice gate. You could leave. Nobody ever does, but you could.

encounters.name: Hold the Gatehouse
encounters.desc: Survive 4 rounds. They keep coming. You may win early by killing everything.
encounters.intro: Four rounds. That is all I ask. Then they get bored.

encounters.name: The Drowned Sergeant
encounters.desc: Kill the sergeant (the elite footman) and the rest lose their nerve. You don't need to kill anyone else.
encounters.intro: Cut off the head. The rest of the body has never been very bright.

encounters.name: Parade of the Bloated
encounters.desc: Three heralds around a pit, and a priest to heal them. Ranged attacks and shoves into the pit both work.
encounters.intro: A parade. They have been rehearsing.

encounters.name: The King's Remains
encounters.desc: Everything the kingdom has left, in one long hall.
encounters.intro: The king's honour guard. What remains of it. What remains of him.

encounters.name: The Leech Matron
encounters.desc: She regenerates every turn and breeds leeches. Burst her down; fire helps.
encounters.intro: She is very old and very hungry, and she has a great many children.

encounters.name: Sergeants of the Deep
encounters.desc: Two veteran footmen and a bulwark to shelter them.
encounters.intro: The veterans. They drowned with their boots on.

encounters.name: The Undertow
encounters.desc: An elder tide-priest floods the court while crossbows cover him.
encounters.intro: The elder of the tide. He has been praying for this.

encounters.name: The Harpooners
encounters.desc: Veteran harpooners on a broken bridge. They will pull you toward the holes.
encounters.intro: They fish for people here. You are the catch of the day.

encounters.name: The Rust-Tide Knight
encounters.desc: He swore an oath to a drowned king. His armour rearranges the rubble every other round, and his tidal charge is telegraphed: step out of the marked line.
encounters.intro: He swore an oath to a king who drowned. The oath did not drown.

encounters.name: The Bloated Magistrate
encounters.desc: He eats the floor, two tiles a turn, nearest first. Pits swallow anything shoved into them. His bailiffs come in pairs.
encounters.intro: Court is in session. The Magistrate is hungry. He eats the floor first.

optional.text: Win before the floor is gone (7 rounds)
